Rating sabse achhi, par sirf athaarah reviews, aur timing hi nahi daali. Google ne neeche daal diya.

items: *Timing* nahi daali: "open now" search mein gayab
Sirf *18 reviews*, last review 5 mahine purana

scenes.sub: Comment AUDIT: hum free 60-sec audit karenge
scenes.say: Comment karo AUDIT, aapka free audit karenge. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.

caption:
Ek clinic ka Google profile 60 second mein audit kiya. Rating 4.9 thi, phir bhi "dentist near me" mein neeche. Kyun? 🦷

❌ Timing nahi daali, isliye "open now" mein gayab
❌ Sirf 18 reviews, last wala 5 mahine purana
❌ Photos mein sirf logo
❌ Booking ka WhatsApp button nahi

✅ 30 min ka fix: hours bharo, har patient ko review link, har mahine 5 asli photos, "Book" = WhatsApp chat.

(Example profile, naam hide kiya hai.)

Comment "AUDIT" 👇 aapka profile free check karenge.

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.

🏢 Parachar: local businesses ke liye websites, WhatsApp automation aur lead follow-up systems. Leads aayein, chhootein nahi.
